mina_kato: Quick heads-up: onboarding nebula-mini-q4f on staging. Small QA found weird tokenization when invisible chars appear between katakana and kanji (ZWSP U+200B, ZWJ U+200D). Embedding similarity to fp16 baseline drops on short retrievals. Anyone seen tokenizer fast-path issues post-quant?

diego_ramos: Which tokenizer version & export pipeline? Minimal repro please.

mina_kato: rn-tokenizer v2.6.0 vendored. Repro commands: rn_tokenizer inspect --model nebula-mini --mode fp16 --text "カナ​漢" and same for q4f. fp16 tokens -> ["カナ"," 漢"] ids [3120,9872]. q4f -> ["カナ​"," 漢"] ids [3120,41231]. So ZWSP attached, second id remapped high.

elaine_cho: Likely normalization disabled in q4f build. Check build flags: TOKEN_NORM=fast?

mina_kato: Confirmed q4f image built with TOKEN_NORM=fast to save cycles; fp16 uses TOKEN_NORM=full.

diego_ramos: Impact numbers?

mina_kato: Small JA retrieval sample (n=140): ~20% show boundary attach with invisible chars. For affected samples mean embedding cosine falls 0.93->0.78; retrieval recall@10 down ~5 points. BLEU for NMT barely changes (~0.1) because detok normalizes.

build-bot: started job nebula-mini-q4f-zwsp-smoke-2789456123

elaine_cho: Short-term fix: pre-normalize inputs at gateway (NFKC) and optionally strip ZWSP/ZWJ. Long-term: re-enable full normalization for q4f or expose toggle. Also add CI tests for invisible chars.

diego_ramos: Add packer guard to assert token id stability (no unexpected remap > vocab_size + 1024). Also bisect export if remap persists.

mina_kato: Rolled gateway strip_zw=true to staging; re-run smoke: affected cosine median recovered to ~0.90 and recall restored ~4.6 pts. Filing ticket INF-6210 "Invisible-char attachment in q4f fast-tokenize" with repro and smoke.

elaine_cho: I'll add tokenizer CI tests (ZWSP/ZWJ/thin-space/NBSP) and a tiny nightly comparison against fp16 for multilingual edgecases.

mina_kato: TL;DR: root cause = fast normalize off in q4f build -> invisible char attaches to preceding token -> id remap & embedding drift -> retrieval regression. Mitigation = gateway strip + ticket to decide default behavior. Rolling canary to Dedicated later today.
